+The Decisions API is now generally available with gpt-6-luna. Cache shared input across requests for prompt-cache discounts, include images in individual question instructions, and pass structured data directly with input_json. Each request now supports up to 400 questions, increased from 200 in public beta. Review the changes since public beta.
